plain: Too much praise and flattery, especially of the powerful.

webster.text: Servile flattery; praise in excess, or beyond what is merited; high compliment.

example.quote: The language and manners of this court will be what distinguishes them from the rest of the community, not what assimilates them to it, and in being remarked for a behavior that shews they are not meanly born , and in adulation to people of fortune and power.
example.cite: Cato, Letter IV, New York Journal
